ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Fraud on Minnesota's Healthcare System
ideas.description: Investigate the $90 million Medicaid fraud case in Minneapolis and its implications for Minnesota's healthcare system.
questions: What are the root causes of Medicaid fraud?
How can we prevent similar cases in the future?
ideas.insight: This story would shed light on the significant issue of Medicaid fraud and its impact on healthcare in Minnesota.

ideas.title: The Rise of Child Care Fraud: Causes and Consequences
ideas.description: Explore the issue of child care fraud and efforts to protect funding and prevent scams.
ideas.angle: Child care funding and fraud prevention
questions: What are the common schemes used in child care fraud?
How effective are current prevention measures?
ideas.insight: This story would provide valuable insights into the issue of child care fraud and potential solutions.
